force_mask_rule: stance true and the foot's owned-plate vertical force below 20 N -> grf vertical/anterior/lateral missing. 20 N fixed before results: 1.5x the ~13 N levelground Treadmill-plate offset, same as GT23 rule, absolute not BW fraction. Stored as layer force_mask/<ID>/<mode>/<rec>.parquet (time_s, force_missing_left/right); apply_force_mask() sets NaN.
